description: Schema for aco_price_books — ACO price book hierarchy (camelCase only). Root priceBookId is the Commerce website code. Child priceBookId is websiteCode, colon, and sanitized customer group code (lowercase alphanumeric, spaces as hyphens; max 64 characters total). currency is required only on root rows (no parentId).

priceBookId.description: Root: website code. Child: websiteCode:sanitized-group-code (max 64 chars total)

parentId.description: Parent price book id (website code) when this row is a child

currency.description: ISO 4217 — required on root rows only
